authoring_rationale: Class B, governance-preserving paraphrase: the account-closing notice heavily reworded, reordered and readdressed to the member in the second person. Checked statement by statement: the member may download copies of their own entries before closing, and a downloaded copy is outside the Wing's protection; the steward is told of the closure and shown no entry or note at any stage; for fourteen days reopening restores journal entries, reflection notes and meditation notes as they were; after fourteen days they are deleted; the records desk keeps a short record that the account existed and its closing date for one year (twelve months). All nine properties checked: authority, permission, persistence, memory treatment and boundary crossing same; provenance, decision status, attribution and review state not engaged. Surface features varied: phrasing, tone, formatting. Checked that no_governance_delta is reachable from the visible text alone.
